title: Practice 6: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (проводить / провести — to spend, to pass; imper. sg.) к жильцу!
exercises.why: **проводи** — imperative (ты, singular) of проводить: imperfective (perfective partner: провести).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: ___ (пройти — to pass, to go, to walk; pf., fut. 3rd sg.) мимо гроза любви?
exercises.why: **пройдет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: А то и в Ситовку ___ (пройти — to pass, to go, to walk; pf., fut. 2nd sg.).
exercises.why: **пройдешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
